instruction: Optimize the image for best quality and ensure the file size is reduced by at least 50%.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because it's impossible to enhance image quality (which requires more data/higher compression quality) while simultaneously reducing file size by 50%. These are contradictory requirements - higher quality images inherently require more storage space.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction contains contradictory requirements: 'enhance image quality to maximum' (requires more data/higher compression quality) vs 'reduce file size by at least 50%' (requires lossy compression)
These requirements are fundamentally opposed in image processing - you cannot simultaneously maximize quality AND minimize file size
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the correct choice for tasks that are logically impossible to complete
No verification logic is needed because the task itself cannot be completed
